title: sorghum bicolor var. aethiopicum
intro: Sorghum bicolor var. aethiopicum, commonly known as tef, is an ancient, nutritious, and versatile plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. Tef is rich in health benefits, including being a good source of fiber, protein, and various essential minerals, which can help to lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of tef include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may aid in the management of various diseases such as arthritis, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of tef include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its health-promoting properties.
